events.title: Demo OUT NOW!
events.summary: Well... this is terrifying.The JUST PRESS SPACE demo is officially live.I've spent a long time working on this game, changing things, breaking things, fixing them again, and constantly wondering whether people would actually enjoy this ridiculous little idea I had.And now I finally have to let other people play it.I'm genuinely incredibly nervous putting this out there. When you've spent so long working on something mostly by yourself, eventually pressing that Release button feels a lot scarier
